zh-Hans: 能一直咬到最后吗？我可要一口气冲到终点了！
en: Can you stay with me to the end? I'm charging straight for the finish!

zh-Hans: 好路线，连我这个本地人看了都佩服！
en: What a line. Even a local like me has to admire it!

zh-Hans: 真难缠，普通的进攻根本不管用。
en: He's tough. A half-hearted move won't work on him.

zh-Hans: 像穿针引线一样冲过伊吕波坂，真快！
en: He's threading his way through Irohazaka. Fast!

zh-Hans: 什么来头？这么难的路段，他竟然轻松就过了！
en: What a driver! He makes this difficult section look easy!

zh-Hans: 好厉害，真是惊人的技术！
en: He's good. Incredible technique!

zh-Hans: 可恶，我一定要追上！
en: Damn it, I'll catch you!

zh-Hans: 别以为就这样能逃掉！
en: Don't think you can get away like this!

zh-Hans: 一旦怀疑自己的跑法，就已经输了！我对自己的技术有信心！
en: The moment you doubt your own driving, you've lost! I believe in my skills!

zh-Hans: 能快到这种地步，我没话说。
en: If you're that fast, I've got no complaints.

zh-Hans: 来得好，这也正是我想要的！
en: Good. That's exactly what I wanted!

zh-Hans: 刚才那是什么？发生了什么事？
en: What was that? What just happened?

zh-Hans: 到底发生了什么？可恶！
en: What the hell just happened?! Damn it!

zh-Hans: 糟了！
en: I blew it!

zh-Hans: 可恶！
en: Ugh!

zh-Hans: 呜！
en: Ugh!

zh-Hans: 啊！
en: Gah!

zh-Hans: 糟了！
en: Damn it!

zh-Hans: 不可能！
en: Impossible!

zh-Hans: 几乎找不出一点破绽。
en: There's barely a single opening.

zh-Hans: 这家伙简直是天生的山路高手！
en: He's an absolute natural on the mountain passes!

zh-Hans: 今晚的落叶还真多。
en: There are a lot of leaves out tonight.

zh-Hans: 这样就想逼我？看我甩掉你！
en: You call that pressure? I'll shake you off!

zh-Hans: 确实很快，不过也到此为止！
en: You're quick, but this is as far as you go!

zh-Hans: 有两下子，但我不会让你超过去！
en: You're good, but you're not getting past me!

zh-Hans: 太嫩了，本地跑法你可跟不上！
en: Not good enough. You can't follow a local's line!

zh-Hans: 终点近了，该做个了断了！
en: The finish is close. Time to settle this!

zh-Hans: 一口气分出胜负，别怪我啊！
en: I'll finish this in one shot. No hard feelings!

zh-Hans: 拿下了！接下来只要甩掉你！
en: Got you! Now I just have to pull away!

zh-Hans: 别怪我。比贴内线更靠里的，是画在空中的路线！
en: No hard feelings. The line farther inside than the inside... is the one through the air!

zh-Hans: 一旦让我跑到前面，你就再没机会了！
en: Once you let me take the lead, you haven't got a chance!

zh-Hans: 就是这里，冲！
en: Right here! Go!

zh-Hans: 机会只有现在，上了！
en: It's now or never! Here goes!

zh-Hans: 就是现在！
en: Now!

zh-Hans: 就是那里！
en: Right there!

zh-Hans: 老爸，感觉真不错！
en: This feels good, Dad!

zh-Hans: 一切都在计划之中！
en: Everything's going to plan!

zh-Hans: 这场较量，我赢了！
en: This battle is mine!

zh-Hans: 在哪儿使出那招，时机才是关键。
en: Where I use that move... Getting the timing right is what matters.
